name: LastRepairedPrice
description: It will return you the price when the instrument was last repaired. It captures the last repaired price of the instrument you are trading and not the underlying. It gets updated whenever there is a repair or an exit triggered in any set.

LastRepairedPrice
It will return you the price when the instrument was last repaired. It captures the last repaired price of the instrument you are trading and not the underlying. It gets updated whenever there is a repair or an exit triggered in any set.
